stories.t: Iran's Khamenei warns US and Israel against new attacks
stories.s: Iran's supreme leader warned the United States and Israel on Saturday against further strikes as tensions mount over a possible return to fighting. US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have threatened new…
stories.tz: 伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊警告美以切勿发动新袭击
stories.sz: 随着对可能重燃战火的紧张局势不断升级，伊朗最高领袖于周六警告美国和以色列不要采取进一步打击行动。此前，美国总统特朗普和以色列总理内塔尼亚胡已威胁将发动新的……

stories.t: Emotional reunions with loved ones for Oleshky evacuees
stories.s: The BBC's Dan Johnson travelled to the northern Ukrainian border with Belarus after evacuated Oleshky residents arrived in buses and ambulances following a temporary ceasefire.
stories.tz: 奥列什基撤离人员与亲人悲喜重逢
stories.sz: 在临时停火期间，奥列什基的撤离居民乘坐大巴和救护车抵达乌克兰北部与白俄罗斯边境，BBC记者丹·约翰逊前往现场进行了报道。

stories.t: More than 5,000 die from Ebola in DR Congo's deadliest outbreak
stories.s: Government data shows that more than 10,000 people have contracted the rare virus.
stories.tz: 刚果（金）暴发史上最严重埃博拉疫情，死亡人数超5000人
stories.sz: 政府数据显示，已有超过1万人感染了这种罕见病毒。

stories.t: Ethiopian PM puts ministers through military training
stories.s: The prime minister has previously emphasised military preparedness as central to his government's ambitions.
stories.tz: 埃塞俄比亚总理安排内阁大臣参加军事训练
stories.sz: 这位总理此前曾强调，军事备战是其政府雄心壮志的核心所在。

stories.t: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
stories.s: The American-made interceptors are the only effective weapon for downing Russia's ballistic missiles.
stories.tz: 美国批准向乌克兰出售500枚“爱国者”导弹
stories.sz: 这种美国制造的拦截弹是击落俄罗斯弹道导弹的唯一有效武器。

stories.t: CCTV and zip ties: How US mail-in votes are secured and counted
stories.s: BBC Verify goes to an election centre to get a behind-the-scenes look at how mail-in ballots for the US midterm elections are processed.
stories.tz: 闭路电视与扎带：美国邮寄选票如何确保安全并被统计
stories.sz: BBC核查栏目（BBC Verify）前往一个选举中心，幕后探访美国中期选举邮寄选票的处理过程。

stories.t: Bollywood and the underworld — together in the spotlight?
stories.s: A wave of shootings and extortion threats has rattled India's film industry. This time, those claiming responsibility are very different from the Mumbai underworld that had Bollywood in its grip back in the 1990s.
stories.tz: 宝莱坞与黑社会——再次成为聚焦点？
stories.sz: 一连串的枪击事件和勒索威胁震动了印度电影业。这一次，宣称负责的势力与20世纪90年代控制宝莱坞的孟买黑社会有着很大不同。

stories.t: Spain train disaster clouds Sánchez chances of re-election
stories.s: The Spanish PM is hit by a succession of crises just weeks before a snap general election.
stories.tz: 西班牙列车灾难为桑切斯赢得连任蒙上阴影
stories.sz: 在几周后的提前大选之前，这位西班牙首相接连遭遇一系列危机。
